name: Mixture of Experts top-k routing
description: Only 2 of the 4 run per token

data.noteContent:
A mixture-of-experts layer replaces a Transformer block's feed-forward network with several of them plus a gate that decides which to use. Only the chosen 2 of the 4 run for any one token, so capacity grows without the cost growing with it. Nothing here is trained: the input is a random [2, 5, 32] batch and the experts are built from seed 42, so read the three prints as the mechanism, not as a result. Switch Transformer, Mixtral and DeepSeek-MoE are this, scaled up.

MoE 層把 Transformer block 裡的前饋網路換成好幾個，再加一個 gate 決定要用哪些。每個 token 只跑選中的 2 個（共 4 個），所以容量變大，計算量不用跟著變大。這裡沒有任何東西訓練過：輸入是隨機的 [2, 5, 32]，專家用 seed 42 建出來，所以三個 Print 要當成機制看，不是結果。Switch Transformer、Mixtral、DeepSeek-MoE 就是把這個放大。

output is [B, T, H] -- the same shape that went in, which is what lets an MoE layer drop into the slot a plain feed-forward block sat in.

output 是 [B, T, H]，和輸入同形狀，所以 MoE 層可以直接放進原本擺一般前饋區塊的位置。

routing_weights is how the gate split a token between its two picks; the pair sums to 1. Untrained, the winner takes about 0.59 -- barely a preference. A trained gate is far more decisive.

routing_weights 是 gate 把一個 token 分給兩位專家的比重，兩個加起來是 1。沒訓練過的 gate，贏家大約只拿 0.59，幾乎談不上偏好；訓練過的 gate 會果斷得多。

expert_indices is which 2 of the 4 experts each token was routed to. Read it beside the weights above and you have the choice and the confidence behind it together.

expert_indices 是每個 token 被送到哪 2 位專家（共 4 位）。和上面的權重一起看，就同時知道它選了誰、又有多篤定。
